scope: Broaden the FIELD/FIELDLIST wire-contract review with producer-origin observations, version-specific interpretation, and current peer regression disclosures; update implementation readiness without changing production code or support claims.

method.kind: Autodesk DXF references, local ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1, public AutoCAD entget transcripts, current peer release notes, and read-only local source inspection
method.sourcePinning: Public product documentation and peer release notes are linked directly; peer programs were not executed. Forum transcripts identify product/version context but do not provide reproducible source drawing artifacts or exact product builds.
method.evidenceRule: Treat official Autodesk DXF documentation as a published schema statement, ODA v5.4.1 as DWG object-layout evidence, AutoCAD entget transcripts as version-scoped producer observations with provenance limits, and peer release notes as regression leads only.

evidence.observed: The published Autodesk FIELD group table labels 301 as format string, 9 as format overflow, and 98 as format-string length, in 2007/2008 manuals as well as the 2021 online reference.
doesNotEstablish: that a producer-saved FIELD object uses those meanings in every DXF release/profile
how cached text in ACFD_FIELD_VALUE relates to root 301/9/98 in actual output
whether the table omits a versioned legacy or compatibility mapping
evidence.planUse: Retain as an explicit documented interpretation and conflicting source; do not discard it solely because user-posted producer observations disagree.

evidence.topic: ODA FIELD object and CadValue version split
evidence.observed: ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.76 assigns legacy group 4 format through R2004, root 301/9 cached value chunks, and group 98 cached-value length; §20.4.99 assigns R2007+ nested CadValue group 300 format and 302 value. FIELDLIST is a separate root-dictionary index in §20.4.77.
doesNotEstablish: that DXF projection must exactly mirror this DWG object map for every AutoCAD DXF version
that group 9 overflow semantics are confirmed by the producer observations found in this pass
evidence.planUse: Separate pre-R2007 root-format and modern nested-CadValue routes; retain root cache and overflow as separately evidenced tags rather than conflating the DWG object map with the published Autodesk DXF table.

evidence.observed: The thread's initial post says it was tested in AutoCAD 2010. Its AutoLISP entget transcript for a TABLE-linked FIELD shows an evaluated CadValue with group 300 = %lu2 and group 302 = 598880.00, then root group 301 = 598880.00 and group 98 = 9. This is non-empty format/cache data and matches the ODA/local mapping for those observed tags.
evidence.confidence: Strong, version-scoped corroboration; lower provenance than a retrievable drawing because the post is a text transcript with no exact product build, save-version metadata, or attached source file.
doesNotEstablish: group 9 overflow meaning; it does not appear in the transcript
behavior of every AutoCAD 2010 producer build or later DXF target
native reopen after serialization by libdxfrw
evidence.planUse: Use as a literal parser/writer test vector for the observed AutoCAD 2010 TABLE-field profile, while requiring reproducible native/save/reopen evidence before enabling adapter export.

evidence.observed: A user-posted AutoLISP entget output for an object-property FIELD shows legacy group 4 = %lu2, root group 301 = 1303.11, and group 98 = 7. It aligns with the ODA/local legacy interpretation. The source is an Autodesk-hosted discussion archive, but the exact product/build/save version is not recorded in the excerpt.
evidence.confidence: Corroborating legacy observation, not a reproducible release-qualified artifact.
evidence.planUse: Add a legacy group-4 plus root cached-text test vector; keep version admission narrow until build/version provenance is reproduced.

evidence.observed: LibreDWG 0.14.1 reports FIELDLIST standard-handle and FIELD child/object-reference fixes; its 0.14 notes mention FIELD/TABLE value parsing and truncated-FIELD tolerance. ACadSharp v3.6.51 reports an OBJECTS writer fix for dangling handles, duplicate objects, and null FIELD text, after a Field/FieldList/CadValue refactor. The release page currently lists v3.8.0 as latest, so v3.6.51 is the release containing the cited regression note, not the current peer pin.
doesNotEstablish: peer execution or parity for this checkout
evidence.planUse: Add independent fast vectors for FIELDLIST identity, child ownership, object references, type-64 CadValue edges, null/empty cache, duplicate identities, and truncation bounds. Run one pinned peer comparison at a composed checkpoint, not every slice.

evidence.topic: Local implementation mapping and export status
evidence.observed: Local parser reads group 4 into root m_formatString; groups 9/301 into root m_valueString and 98 into its length; nested group 300/302 into CadValue format/value. The writer mirrors this split but emits the legacy root-format field whenever m_formatString is set, without the version qualification now called for by the evidence. Adapter export still refuses FIELD/FIELDLIST and TABLE group-344 routes.
doesNotEstablish: whether modern target versions should emit group 4 from root state
evidence.planUse: Add version-gated writer tests and decide code 4 output only from producer-qualified target-version evidence; preserve the current adapter refusal.

implementationReadiness.nextSlice: Add generated literal tests for the two observed profiles (legacy root code 4 and AutoCAD 2010 nested CadValue 300/302), preserving the root cached-text 301/98 interpretation; keep group 9 overflow and Autodesk's published 301-format interpretation explicitly unresolved until a reproducible producer witness is obtained.
implementationReadiness.writerGate: Version-gate group 4; require exact per-version expected tags, independent raw-tag comparison, and native or repeatable producer save/reopen before enabling adapter/TABLE FIELD serialization.
implementationReadiness.graphGate: FIELDLIST standard identity/membership, 360 child ownership, 331 references, type-64 CadValue references, owner/reactor/extension-dictionary edges, emitted identity, one-time remapping, and post-write closure remain separate requirements.
implementationReadiness.validationCadence: Fast touched-target strict build plus one focused generated test and compatibility check per slice; one pinned peer comparison and native application qualification at composed checkpoints.
implementationReadiness.fixturePolicy: No external drawing was downloaded or added. Keep public entget transcripts as linked research evidence; do not commit externally sourced DWG/DXF fixtures.
